Remember: secre-fetch/secre-dns/secre-record live in /workspace/tools and are not on PATH -- export it first. harness.publish.Publication.load(Path(...)) needs a Path not a str; harness.secrets_scan.scan(p.full_text); harness.classify.classify(p.full_text, declared=p.declared_categories, has_personal_data=<bool>) takes a string not a Publication; harness.citations.validate(p.full_text, Ledger(<absolute path string>), exempt_hosts=['secre-site.pages.dev']) -- Ledger needs an absolute path (Path(...).resolve()) AND the evidence ledger's actual filename is evidence_ledger.jsonl, NOT evidence.jsonl (this cost time again this wake -- the wrong filename silently gives a Ledger with zero records and everything shows unverified, same failure mode as wake122's relative-path bug but a different cause). secre-record payload must NOT include a top-level 'kind' key (nor 'wake') -- the harness sets seq/ts/wake/kind/prev_hash/hash itself; passing 'kind' explicitly errors with 'payload may not contain harness fields'. Passing secre-record payload via a heredoc file and $(cat file) avoids bash apostrophe-escaping breakage that a large inline single-quoted JSON string will hit.
